title: nf-meta-samplesheet-ops pipeline parameters
description: Generalized Nextflow adapter for pandas-style samplesheet/metadata operations (merge, drop, dropna, drop_duplicates, filter, concat) on one or two CSV/TSV samplesheets.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Samplesheet inputs, the ordered operation chain, and where/how the result is written.

samplesheet1.description: Path to the primary CSV/TSV samplesheet.
samplesheet1.help_text: This is the samplesheet that the operation chain runs against, starting as-is and getting transformed op by op. Delimiter is auto-detected from the file extension.
samplesheet1.errorMessage: samplesheet1 must be a valid file path with no spaces, ending in .csv, .tsv, or .tab, and must exist.

samplesheet2.description: Path to the second CSV/TSV samplesheet.
samplesheet2.help_text: Required only when `--ops` includes `merge` or `concat`. Always read fresh -- it is not itself transformed by earlier ops in the chain, only samplesheet1's running state is.
samplesheet2.errorMessage: samplesheet2 must be a valid file path with no spaces, ending in .csv, .tsv, or .tab, and must exist.

ops.description: Ordered, comma-separated list of operations to apply left-to-right.
ops.help_text: Allowed values: `merge`, `drop_columns`, `select_columns`, `dropna`, `drop_duplicates`, `filter`, `concat`. An op name can only appear once per run, e.g. `merge,drop_columns,filter`.
ops.errorMessage: ops must be a comma-separated list made up only of: merge, drop_columns, select_columns, dropna, drop_duplicates, filter, concat.

outdir.description: Directory the output samplesheet is written to.

outname.help_text: The extension controls the output format: `.csv` writes comma-delimited, `.tsv`/`.tab` writes tab-delimited.

quote.description: Quote character used both when parsing input CSV/TSV and when quoting output fields.

merge_options.title: merge options
merge_options.description: Arguments for the 'merge' op (joins samplesheet1's running state with samplesheet2).

merge_on.description: Single shared key column present in both sheets to join on.

merge_how.help_text: `inner` keeps only matching rows. `left` keeps all rows from samplesheet1's running state, blank-filling samplesheet2's columns when unmatched.

merge_suffixes.description: Comma-separated pair of suffixes applied to overlapping non-key column names from (samplesheet1, samplesheet2) respectively.
merge_suffixes.errorMessage: merge_suffixes must be exactly two non-empty, comma-separated values.

drop_columns_cols.description: Comma-separated column names to remove, for the 'drop_columns' op.

select_columns_cols.description: Comma-separated column names to keep, for the 'select_columns' op -- the inverse of drop_columns.
select_columns_cols.help_text: All columns not listed are removed. The output column order follows the order given here. Errors if a listed column doesn't exist.

dropna_cols.description: Comma-separated subset of columns to check for blank values, for the 'dropna' op.
dropna_cols.help_text: Defaults to checking all columns if not set. A row is dropped if any of the listed columns is blank.

drop_duplicates_cols.description: Comma-separated subset of columns forming the dedup key, for the 'drop_duplicates' op.
drop_duplicates_cols.help_text: Defaults to all columns if not set. Keeps the first occurrence per key.

filter_col.description: Column to test, for the 'filter' op.

filter_value.description: Value to compare filter_col against, for the 'filter' op.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised nf-core/configs institutional profiles. These are set automatically when an institutional -profile is used and should not normally be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: This adapter loads institutional profiles the same way nf-core pipelines do, so a metapipeline that applies e.g. `-profile denbi_qbic` (or `-profile <institution>,singularity`) uniformly across every sub-pipeline works here too, without needing this adapter to know about any specific institution.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: When running offline, Nextflow cannot retrieve institutional configuration files from the internet. If needed, download these files from the repository and specify their location with this parameter.
